Aarakocra

*The Kagu are a major, perhaps the only, aarakocra clan.

Connections

*Related to crowfolk, with whom they share a love of shiny things. *The Doge himself owns a number of aarakocra slaves that serve as bodyguards, servants and dancers. They can often be seen wheeling above the city‘s spires (or around the balloons). Category:Birds Category:Creatures Category:Peoples Category:Aarakocra
